name: 劉亮志
objective:
本課程將延續財務工程導論的內容，將持續在衍生性商品評價、避險以及風險控管等問題上繼續深入探討；本學期將把焦點放在股票衍生性商品與利率衍生性商品的評價與避險上，並利用 C (或 C++) 和 Matlab 兩種工具來執行 樹狀結構與蒙地卡羅法  以評價選擇權與公司債的價值。
This course will still focus on the methods for bonds and derivatives pricing and hedging, such as the evaluation of stock and interest rate options. For implementation purposes associated with the concepts introduced, such as the tree structure, two programming languages for computation will be provided: C (or C++ ) and Matlab.
schedule:
Week 1   :  Course Introduction and Preliminary
Week 2   :  Fundamental Economic Features of Stock Options - 1  
Week 3   :  Fundamental Economic Features of Stock Options - 2 
Week 4   :  Functions and Their Applications - 1 
Week 5   :  Functions and Their Applications - 2
Week 6   :  Introduction to Fundamental Option Pricing Theory - 1
Week 7   :  Introduction to Fundamental Option Pricing Theory - 2
Week 8   :  Introduction to Fundamental Option Pricing Theory - 3                       
Week 9   :  Midterm Review and Exercise 
Week 10 :  Tree Method and Extension of Option Pricing Theory - 1 
Week 11 :  Tree Method and Extension of Option Pricing Theory - 2 
Week 12 :  Tree Method and Extension of Option Pricing Theory - 3 
Week 13 :  Tree Method and Extension of Option Pricing Theory - 4
Week 14 :  Monte Carlo Simulation and Option Pricing - 1
Week 15 :  Monte Carlo Simulation and Option Pricing - 2
Week 16 :  Monte Carlo Simulation and Option Pricing - 3
Week 17 :  Take-Home Final Exam 
Week 18 :  Course Review
scorePolicy:
Exercise:  50%
Midterm Exercise: 10%
Take-Home Final Exam: 40%
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL / 專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
